question: Which channel/provider combinations must the Windows repository gate, and which assertions belong upstream in the gateway versus a credentialed Crabbox smoke lane here?
rationale: The gateway owns wizard content, while this repository owns rendering and orchestration; selecting combinations and live secret, cost, retry, and flake policies requires maintainer intent rather than a mechanical test addition.

options.title: Adopt layered coverage
options.body: Keep exhaustive provider/channel logic upstream, retain deterministic protocol tests here, and approve a small credentialed Windows Crabbox smoke matrix.

options.title: Accept representative coverage
options.body: Declare the merged no-auth answer-shaping tests sufficient and narrow the issue's definition of done without adding credentialed validation.

options.title: Own the full matrix here
options.body: Build a larger credentialed Windows matrix and accept the ongoing secret, cost, upstream-version, and flake burden in this repository.

recommendation.title: Adopt layered coverage
recommendation.body: Keep exhaustive provider/channel logic upstream, retain deterministic protocol tests here, and approve a small credentialed Windows Crabbox smoke matrix.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the parent epic and reopened this child issue after the representative coverage landed.
